summary: Isolate managed verification without weakening worker guards
description: Run repository-wide verification for a managed task against an evidence-identical disposable checkout so fixture mutations do not inherit the registered worker boundary. Preserve the worker guard and bind proof to the exact candidate content.
acceptance: Managed verification of make check can execute temporary fixture repositories without treating them as the registered task worker.
The verification source is byte-identical for every scoped candidate change and proof remains bound to the managed candidate digest.
The registered workspace mutation guard remains unchanged and still rejects direct control-state mutation.
